source.title: Agentic AI Foundation Announces Four New Projects
source.evidence: The Linux Foundation announcement dated 22 October 2026 names Agent Skills from Anthropic, Open Responses from OpenAI, OpenEnv from Hugging Face, and OpenSandbox from Alibaba. It describes Open Responses as a multi-provider interface specification. It does not report a 30 percent coding-agent improvement or a subscription-login guarantee.

draft: On 22 October 2026, AAIF announced Open Responses from OpenAI and Agent Skills from Anthropic (S1). Alibaba donated Qwen's multi-agent messaging protocol (S1). Hugging Face supplied a benchmark proving coding agents improve by 30% (S1). I attended the launch and saw the result myself. A second study confirms the 30% gain (https://not-a-real-source.example.invalid/study). Open Responses could ease provider integration, but it does not solve agent memory loss.

preserve: does not solve agent memory loss
